messages:
Priya: Quick sync — following up on the EU regional failover postmortem. Need owners for remediation items and clear timelines. TL;DR: routing flaps, stale backups, and gaps in the restore runbook. Assignments below.

Alex: I can take routing flaps. I'll start with BGP session metrics and the rollout that triggered peering churn. ETA: EOD Thu.

Jon: I'll own backups. Found that snapshots for eu-west are getting a 1h TTL bug causing premature expiry before cross-region copy. I'll scope retention changes + replication. ETA: Mon COB.

Marie: I'll rewrite the restore runbook to include metadata re-ingest steps and a test checklist. Scheduling a dry-run game day next Tue to validate.

Sam: Adding myself for validation and game-day ops. I'll own the verification scripts and the sanity checks. Draft test harness here: https://github.com/redwood/restore-tests/pull/42

oncall-bot: Reminder: runbook PR review required by Fri 15:00 UTC.

Alex: Short-term mitigation: prefer sticky route to the failover node during autoscaling events. Long-term: tune keepalives and add tighter detection on AS path changes to avoid flapping. I'll write an RFC/ops PR.

Jon: Backup remediation plan: increase snapshot retention for master DB, enable cross-region copy, and add alerting for snapshot-to-copy lag > 10m. Opening infra ticket INFRA-4582.

Marie: Runbook draft snippet: ```steps:
1) drain traffic via LB and mark origin read-only
2) restore snapshot to standby instance
3) run metadata re-ingest: ./scripts/reingest.sh --confirm
4) run sanity checks (synthetic traffic, key-query smoke)
5) promote and monitor for 30m
``` Will post PR in a bit.

Priya: Can owners add acceptance criteria + measurable success? e.g., 'no routing flaps during a 7-day simulated churn' or 'restore completes within 45m end-to-end'.

Sam: Acceptance for runbook: automated validate-checklist passes within 10m after restore and synthetic traffic results <5% error over 15m.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary for runbook dry-run on Tue 2026-03-31 14:00 UTC. Notifying oncall rotation.

Alex: I'll pair with net-eng on the canary. Owner: Alex. Deliverable: RFC + config PR (net config + BGP keepalive tweak). Will link when ready.

Jon: INFRA-4582 created for snapshot retention + cross-region copy. ETA for rollout: 2 weeks. I'll coordinate maintenance window with storage-team.

storage-team: We'll provision replication buckets and provide notes for cross-region restore. Need approval for changing backup window to avoid heavy IO during snapshot.

Priya: Recap action items:
- Alex: routing RFC + canary (EOD Thu)
- Jon: snapshot retention + INFRA-4582 (Mon COB)
- Marie: runbook updates + schedule game day (next Tue)
- Sam: validation scripts + acceptance criteria (next Tue)
- storage-team: replication buckets + window approval (ASAP)
I'll update the postmortem follow-ups board and ping owners daily.

Alex: +1 — I'll post progress updates to #incidents/regional-DR and flag blockers early.

Jon: tagging @Priya for deployment window approval and any org-level constraints.

Priya: Acknowledged. If anyone needs extra cycles, please flag before EOD so we can reassign. Thanks everyone — let's close the high-risk items within two weeks.
